title: Discord Fluctuation trio
summary: A necromancer quest releases three named creatures from the Discord Fluctuation.
overview: A necromancer quest releases three named creatures from the Discord Fluctuation.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The eligible necromancer activates the fluctuation through its proximity dialogue.
Prepare for Rargari, Gornogg and Arlagai to appear together.
Assign tanks before the trigger and focus the group on one opponent at a time.
